g.text: MicroBin: public pastebin with a gated janitor door
Anyone can paste and share. Only the janitor crew can browse or delete, through Authentik at the proxy.
A janitor can delete any paste: shared cleanup, by design.
URL deletion is off, so every delete goes through /admin,
which also needs MicroBin's own admin login.
Sources: docs/services/microbin.md. SQLite on NFS is the locking footgun; the JSON database is NFS-safe, so that is what runs.
